en-US.title: AKASHA AI — 47 AI Tools
en-US.subtitle: Chat, Images, Videos, Music, Code
en-US.description:
AKASHA AI is the all-in-one AI platform with 47 tools in a single subscription. Chat with advanced AI models, generate images, videos, music, and code. Create custom AI agents, automate workflows, and access a marketplace of community-built agents.

Features:
- Chat with 3 AI models (Sonnet, Opus, Haiku)
- Generate HD images with FLUX & Midjourney
- Create videos with Runway
- Compose music with Suno
- Generate code in any language
- Build and share custom AI agents
- Marketplace with community agents
- Automation workflows (n8n/Make)
- API access for developers
- 16 languages supported
- XP system with achievements
- Referral program with commissions
- Daily rewards & contests

Plans: Free (10 questions/day), AUTOMATE, CREATE, BUILD from 7€/month, or COMPLET at 22€/month for everything. 14-day free trial.
en-US.keywords: AI,artificial intelligence,chatbot,image generator,video generator,music AI,code generator,AI agents,automation,ChatGPT alternative
